issues.detail: The Greek 'δουναι πνευμα' (to give breath/spirit) is the direct object of 'εδοθη' (was given). The Vietnamese translation 'được ban cho hơi thở để trao cho' implies that the breath was given *in order to give* to the image, whereas the Greek says 'breath was given to him [the image] so that the image might speak'.
